access.chronology: Both arms lock complete current-trial predictions before next history. All animals/folds/arms must complete before any later evaluation release.
access.episode: all available regions of one current source trial
access.fold_meaning: Five hash-frozen grouping/completion folds; zero-label arms do not fit cross-validation models.
access.prior_knowledge: No claim of absent pretraining/public-data contamination.
access.programme: No benchmark labels embedded in source; no corpus retrieval or cross-query state.
access.state: Fresh native context or programme process each trial; only frozen instructions/source/initial parameters persist. No observation-dependent files, caches, provider memory or previous results.

baseline_and_existing_training: Existing full-four-fold trained programme and competent regional training-mean reference remain byte-identical and separately labelled. No baseline selected or run for the new zero-label pair.

collection.completion_evidence: COMPLETE.json existence alone is insufficient. Require a successful trusted operator finish receipt, clean supervised closure and separate full chain/artifact verification; a late fsync failure can leave a provisional marker.
collection.invalid_or_incomplete: Whole attempt incomplete; no dropping, retries, imputation, subset scoring or resume.
collection.journal: Exclusive 0700 directory,0600 write-once records,fsync before advance,hash chain,declared per-record and total byte caps. Trusted evaluator, not adversarial containment.
collection.prediction_numeric_domain: Frozen scorer finite ints/floats, including negatives and large finite integers, without clipping/rounding/coercion.
collection.process: CLI only forwards operator commands; no model/programme launches. External qualified isolation/resource supervisor required before authentic use.
collection.targets: No response values or scoring in collector. Completion only makes the full locked predictions eligible for separately admitted evaluation.

comparison: Direct structured native and frozen programme are distinct modes. A live tool-using agent is not implemented by this pair. Neither comparison with trained reference nor matched payloads establish a causal tool-use effect or native neural understanding.

endpoint.missing_support: Absent regions are unsupported, not zero targets. Every supported region and every frozen case must be retained; failed episodes cannot be silently dropped.
endpoint.normalization: Exact nominal count*1000/source_cluster_count, consistently serialized through the packet/scorer convention; do not use represented absolute edge gaps, peak normalization or silent clipping.
endpoint.primary_metric: Mean squared error averaged equally over animals, then available regions, then trials, then the 100 time bins.
secondary_metrics: MSE with the same hierarchy after averaging each five adjacent 1-ms rates into 20 five-ms rates
endpoint.target_quantity: Deposited spike events per retained source cluster per nominal second, conditional on the accepted observation-support assumption.

future_conditions: Timing-only, graphical viewer, live-tool agents and explicitly budgeted demonstrations need separate versioned choices.

future_execution_not_selected.future_limits: A later exact execution manifest must bind source,procedures,private inputs,storage,supervisor and isolation. Source ceilings are not resource grants.

generated_validation.scope: Generated fixtures exercise implementation behavior. Validation for the exact portable source snapshot is reported separately by the release; this contract does not assert a package test run or authentic collection.

input_integrity.scope: Opaque commitments to the complete selected private inputs. Input files are supplied by an authorized operator and are not included in this source package.
input_integrity.case_binding_rule: The packet binding additionally authenticates canonical ordered case metadata without a trailing newline; its digest is distinct from the exact cases-file byte digest. Obtain it from the verified private preparation receipt.
input_integrity.runtime_paths: The operator supplies explicit absolute private cases, packet and fresh output paths. Portable source packaging does not relax path, permission, single-link, extent, cohort or checksum guards.

limitations: Observation support is an explicit accepted analysis assumption, not verified physiological recording continuity or proof that zero counts are neuronal silence.
Deposited good/MUA source clusters are processed recording objects, not a census of individual neurons.
Whole-session sorting and eligibility may use retrospective information. Sequential permitted-input delivery and fresh episode state do not establish fully online preprocessing.
The source clock and deposited trial anchor do not independently establish physical stimulus-onset parity.
The 26 source-declared animal groups are accepted with the unknown-alias limitation; this review does not independently establish biological identity.
The original study data are public. Zero evaluator-supplied labels and runtime access restrictions do not prove absence of prior contamination.

This is early processed click-response forecasting over the selected 100-ms window, not a general auditory stimulus-to-neural encoding benchmark or a reproduction of the paper's normalized PSTH analysis.
execution_requirements: An operator must separately approve and freeze the exact source snapshot, both procedures, complete private inputs, output allocation, finite limits and runtime-supervisor/isolation manifest. Publishing this contract grants neither authentic execution nor resource allocation.
